name: YuE
description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
one_liner: An AI that writes and performs full songs (vocals and instruments) from just lyrics and a style prompt, and lets you edit the melody and chords like a musician would.
buyer: An indie content creator or small ad agency that needs custom, royalty-free background music or jingles quickly and can't afford a composer or licensed music library subscription.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber or podcaster generates unique intro/outro music and background tracks for every episode instead of paying for stock music licenses.
A small ad agency creates custom jingles for local business clients (radio spots, social ads) on demand, cheaper than hiring a jingle composer.
An indie game developer generates a full adaptive soundtrack for their game without a music budget, since it needs a GPU with 24GB VRAM but no ongoing licensing fees.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted 'custom jingle/background music on demand' service for small businesses and creators using it on the backend.
Sell packs of pre-generated royalty-free tracks in specific styles to content creators.

steal_this: Set up a simple website where a small business types a vibe and gets back a custom 30-second jingle, priced per track — powered by this model on a rented GPU.
